_comment: Shared contract for the Candidate finder's coverage mask (GLOSSARY.md). Each case is read by src/utils/__tests__/CoverageMask.parity.test.js (TranslationEngine.applyProperNouns, Phase 2, over DictionaryManager.findMatchesAtToken: the product) and by src-tauri/src/candidate_finder.rs (mod tests, mask_spans through line_mask_spans). `keys` are the active proper-noun dictionary keys; `masked` lists the spans Phase 2 claims in `text`, as `start` and `length` in characters (code points), left to right. Phase 1 pattern claims are not modeled on either side. Rule: left to right, the longest key at a position wins, unless a position inside its span starts a strictly longer key, which defers it.

cases.name: the longer key at the same start wins
a strictly longer match starting inside the span defers the earlier one
a same-length match starting later loses to the earlier one
a deferral chain ends at the last longer match
a longer match starting after the span does not defer
the longer match at the end of the run defers the earlier one
